name: Anthropic Claude API
tagline: Official Claude API for text generation, vision, tools, and agentic workflows.
description: Anthropic's Messages API for Claude models. Developers send prompts via HTTPS and receive completions with optional streaming, tool use, vision, and computer use. Auth is API-key based; usage is billed per token with tiered rate limits after account setup.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header plus anthropic-version header (e.g. 2023-06-01). Keys from console.anthropic.com; self-serve signup.

pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per input/output tokens by model; see pricing page for current rates.

rate_limits: Tiered by usage tier (e.g. requests/min and tokens/min); exact numbers vary by tier and model — see docs.
use_cases: generate code or text completions with Claude
run tool-using agents that call external functions
analyze images with multimodal Claude models
summarize or extract structured data from documents
